description: TRELLIS.2-4B's ckpts/ tree — upstream's own flat layout, not a diffusers one, which is why the lane is named dit and not diffusers. NINE members in ONE directory and therefore NINE components: three distinct 640-key DiTs separated only by input_layer.weight ([1536, 8] / [1536, 32] / [1536, 64]) and out_layer ([8] / [32]), two of which ship twice at 512 and 1024, plus four fp16 autoencoders that are islands against the bf16 dominant. This is the case that forced component grouping onto key disjointness rather than the folder name.
name: trellis2.dit
